SPEC (REQ-18 n<=0 arm): bytes_eq(_,_,5,5,0) = true; verus certifies the ens L3 (live: forge check exits 0, item L3). SHIPPED TWIN (l1.rs emit_string_runtime_l1): the window-first guard 'if ai_u + n_u > a.data.len() { return false }' returns false at (n=0, ai=5 > len=2). LIVE REPRO: forge check empty_window.th -> L3; forge build --entry run -> binary panics 'thermite L1 contract violation [ens]: bytes_eq(result, result, 5, 5, 0)'. A verus-PROVEN postcondition fails its own always-active runtime check — check/build VALUE divergence (distinct from #280's honest compile failure). Fix direction (generator's call): mirror the spec's n<=0 -> true arm before the window guard.
